notes: DYNAMIC LOOPING: editing tracks while the Studio loop plays now takes effect almost instantly (~150 ms) instead of waiting for the loop to come back around. Under the hood the live loop is scheduled step-by-step in a short rolling window, so painted drum steps, drawn piano-roll notes, pad hits and kit/voice preset swaps all land mid-cycle — and changing a preset no longer silences the rest of the loop. WAV export still renders the full loop bit-perfect.
